verdict.rationale: Cua's first-party docs say Cua Driver lets an agent drive native apps on macOS, Windows and Linux 'through MCP or a CLI'. They also say it works with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor: you install it once and add it to your agent, which is an official MCP server that agents connect to. missing for 10: detailed MCP setup/config docs, a documented tool list or server capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP integration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Cua Driver: lets an agent drive native apps on macOS, Windows and Linux in the background, through MCP or a CLI.
It works with agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. You install it once, add it to your agent, and then ask the agent to do things in your apps.
